cat -n src/trailhead/elevation.py && echo ---- && cat -n src/trailhead/pace.py && echo ---- && cat -n src/trailhead/report.py && echo ---- && grep -rn "elevation\|smooth\|range_\|def " src/trailhead/track.py | head -60
cat -n src/trailhead/track.py && echo ---- && grep -rn "ele\b\|\.ele" src tests | head -40; ls tests; git log --oneline | head
grep -rn -i "none\|gap\|missing\|lost" tests src README* 2>/dev/null; cat tests/conftest.py; cat tests/test_elevation.py | head -80; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
sed -n 25,45p README.md; cat -n src/trailhead/cli.py | head -80; cat -n src/trailhead/report.py | sed -n 30,50p

cat >> tests/test_track.py <<'EOF'


def test_missing_elevation_takes_the_nearest_earlier_one_else_the_later_one():
    track = parse_track("lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,100\n0,0.02,\n0,0.03,120\n0,0.04,\n")
    assert track.elevations() == [100, 100, 100, 120, 120]


def test_track_without_any_elevation_is_an_error():
    with pytest.raises(TrackError):
        parse_track("lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,\n").elevations()
